The Male 22km. event gave us a little more success with Danny Bond (2km), Nigel Whorlow (4km), Mabon Dane (6km), Andrew Goudie (4km) and John Hall (6km) making up the 'A' Team.
Unfortunately Danny Bond had a bad day and had to withdraw after 3km while Robert Matelle never got started after gashing his leg while running to the start.

Danny Bond, competing in only his third 5km race since moving up an age group in October, found the the course hard going. He nearly pulled out after 3km but managed to continue on to finish and add to his league score ready for the final match to follow in December.
Danny Bond, being the only Bels walker left to complete all three races came home 4th and took the Overall 3rd place in the Handicap section of the league.
